text:
mira: quick follow-up on parceling experiment: proposing a "parcel heartbeat" + multiplexed stream to reduce wasted prefetch and RPC pressure. basic idea: each parcel emits periodic heartbeats while making progress; scheduler only extends prefetch horizon while heartbeats continue. multiplex parcels over a single GRPC stream to avoid extra connections. thoughts?

lee: sounds good. how do you define progress? token emission or kernel accept?

mira: token emission or runtime ACK. heartbeat_interval default 50ms; leash_timeout 200ms. two consecutive misses before eviction to avoid flapping.

noah: network jitter could still cause premature evictions. we should smooth with leaky-bucket and tune per-tenant latency.

mira: agreed. use small smoothing window and expose tenant latency stats for adaptive thresholds.

samir: operational/compatibility: Dedicated customers will expect no cross-host migration. how do we honor that?

mira: introduce parceling_mode flag: "strict" (no cross-host migration) vs "elastic" (allow fallback). heartbeat mechanics stay local; only fallback routing differs.

lee: protocol sketch idea to multiplex:
```proto
message ParcelStart { string request_id = 1; int32 parcel_idx = 2; int32 token_hint = 3; }
message ParcelHeartbeat { string request_id = 1; int32 parcel_idx = 2; int32 emitted = 3; }
message ParcelFinish { string request_id = 1; int32 parcel_idx = 2; }
```

noah: headroom accounting: two-tier credits: soft_prefetch_credit (evictable) and hard_exec_credit. prefetch credits reclaimed first. ledger should expose soft_prefetch_in_use and hard_exec_in_use metrics per-tenant.

samir: billing: make sure prefetch doesn't inflate billed usage. billing ties to tokens emitted; only count prefetch bytes if they survive eviction window. add FAQ entry.

mira: telemetry/alerts: parcel_active_count_gauge, parcel_eviction_counter{reason}, parcel_latency_histogram, parcel_prefetch_waste_ratio. alert if reassembly adds >10% to request P99.

lee: QA tests: jitter simulation, client pause mid-request, large concurrency of tiny requests to validate eviction stability. also test cancel mid-parcel.

noah: experiments: rollout to staging (2b models) with mux+heartbeat. measure: request P50/P95/P99, prefetch_eviction_rate, connection_count, billing-delta. targets: <2% P99 regression, 10-20% headroom peak reduction, prefetch_waste <5%. 2-week run.

mira: action items: (1) update RFC with protocol sketch, headroom ledger design, telemetry table, and experiment plan; (2) infra to review admission API knobs; (3) QA to add reassembly/cancel tests; (4) rollout: feature-flag -> opt-in customers -> canary -> GA.

samir: add logs for cross-parcel hops and billing attribution details for debugging.

ops-bot: feature-flag "parcel-heartbeat-mux" enabled in staging at 2024-06-22T09:10Z :rocket:

lee: one more idea: adaptive parcel sizing. if a request progresses quickly, grow next parcel to reduce overhead; shrink if stalls. include as post-canary extension.

mira: good call. I'll add adaptive sizing section in the RFC. will open PR and tag reviewers today.
